title: Fits the SII's weighted least squares regression model — fit_sii
text: Fit line form $$   y = \alpha + \beta x_i + \epsilon_i $$ minimises: $$\sum{weights * \epsilon^2}$$ SII taken \(\beta\). fully given expected inputs: $$  \text{Early Diagnosis %} = \text{Intercept} + \text{SII} * \text{Scaled  Deprivation} + \text{Error} $$
